blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected all five V117 views and six current poses. The build report records 2,718 within-panel posterior edges; 26 have baseline dihedral over 60 degrees and the maximum is 179.10 degrees. Contour placement is clamped to 0.00000340, so the continuity constraint preserves the severe existing folds by effectively preventing placement instead of resolving the surface.

The current render remains almost entirely white with a narrow lilac diagonal chest strip and sparse piping. The lamé material response and fencing-practice identity are not legible in the required views.

Crouch and sit retain skirt/shorts intersections and abrupt folds; prone retains a broad disk-like skirt flare. Avatar fit, final skin weights, Shape Key response, validated UVs, Unity/VRChat execution and package eligibility remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
